newsHighlights.title: Shanghai wins inaugural city of innovation award
newsHighlights.summary: Shanghai has been declared one of the winners of the first WIPO City of Innovation award in recognition of its ability to leverage intellectual property rights to drive innovation, protect ideas and scale solutions.
newsHighlights.translation: 上海被宣布为首届WIPO创新城市奖的获奖城市之一，以表彰其运用知识产权推动创新、保护创意并推广解决方案的能力。

newsHighlights.title: World's largest industrial fair opens in Shanghai
newsHighlights.summary: The world's largest industrial fair has opened in Shanghai, showcasing cutting-edge robotics, artificial intelligence and smart manufacturing technologies from around the globe.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球规模最大的工业博览会在上海开幕，展示了来自世界各地的尖端机器人、人工智能和智能制造技术。

newsHighlights.title: Xi urges strong steps to build Healthy China
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping has called for continuous efforts to improve people's health and secure decisive progress in the development of the Healthy China Initiative over the 15th Five-Year Plan period.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席呼吁持续努力改善人民健康，并在“十五五”规划期间推动健康中国建设取得决定性进展。

newsHighlights.title: Xi puts forward four proposals on China-Africa mining cooperation
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping put forward four proposals on China-Africa mining cooperation, calling for technology transfer, green development and deeper industrial collaboration.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席就中非矿业合作提出四点倡议，呼吁加强技术转让、绿色发展和更深层次的产业合作。

quote.quote: The science of today is the technology of tomorrow.
quote.author: Edward Teller
quote.translation: 今天的科学，就是明天的技术。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒我们，基础研究与创新成果终将转化为改变生活的实际技术。正如上海凭借知识产权驱动创新、从实验室走向产业化的历程所展示的那样。

vocabulary.example: Shanghai has become a national leader in technological innovation.
vocabulary.translation: 上海已成为全国科技创新的领军者。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 “Shanghai wins inaugural city of innovation award”，指上海运用知识产权推动创新。

vocabulary.definition: 知识产权（缩写为 IP / IPR）
vocabulary.example: The city uses intellectual property rights to protect ideas and reward inventors.
vocabulary.translation: 这座城市利用知识产权保护创意并激励发明者。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “…in recognition of its ability to leverage intellectual property rights to drive innovation”。

vocabulary.example: Shanghai leverages its research institutions to turn ideas into products.
vocabulary.translation: 上海利用其科研机构把创意转化为产品。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “its ability to leverage intellectual property rights to drive innovation”。

vocabulary.example: The inaugural WIPO City of Innovation award attracted dozens of applicants.
vocabulary.translation: 首届WIPO创新城市奖吸引了数十个申请城市。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自标题 “Shanghai wins inaugural city of innovation award”，意为“首届的”。

vocabulary.example: Once a pilot project succeeds, the city works to scale the solution nationwide.
vocabulary.translation: 试点项目一旦成功，这座城市就努力把解决方案推广到全国。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “protect ideas and scale solutions”，指把成功的方案规模化推广。

vocabulary.example: The Healthy China Initiative aims to improve public health across the country.
vocabulary.translation: “健康中国”倡议旨在提升全国公共健康水平。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “the development of the Healthy China Initiative over the 15th Five-Year Plan”。

vocabulary.example: Ensuring people's health must be given strategic priority.
vocabulary.translation: 必须把保障人民健康放在战略优先位置。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “Xi on building a healthy China”：ensuring people's health must be given strategic priority。

vocabulary.definition: 取得，确保（尤指通过努力获得）
vocabulary.example: China aims to secure decisive progress in health development by 2030.
vocabulary.translation: 中国力争到2030年在健康事业上取得决定性进展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 “secure decisive progress in the development of the Healthy China Initiative”。

vocabulary.example: The industrial fair showcases the latest artificial intelligence and robotics.
vocabulary.translation: 这场工业博览会展示了最先进的人工智能与机器人技术。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 “World's largest industrial fair opens in Shanghai”，博览会是技术展示的平台。

vocabulary.example: Health is the most important indicator of people's happiness.
vocabulary.translation: 健康是人民幸福最重要的指标。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自引语 “Health is the most important indicator of people's happiness.”

pattern.pattern: In recognition of + 名词/动名词, ... has been + 过去分词 ...（鉴于/为表彰……，……被授予/被认定为……）
pattern.example: In recognition of its ability to leverage intellectual property rights to drive innovation, Shanghai has been declared one of the winners of the first WIPO City of Innovation award.
pattern.translation: 鉴于其运用知识产权推动创新的能力，上海被宣布为首届WIPO创新城市奖的获奖城市之一。
pattern.usage: 常用于正式新闻与颁奖、表彰语境。In recognition of 后接原因，主句多用被动语态（has been declared / has been awarded）。可替换为 Thanks to / Owing to，但正式程度略低。

grammar.title: 现在完成时的被动语态（Present Perfect Passive）
grammar.explanation: 结构为 have/has + been + 过去分词，表示“到目前为止已经被……”，强调动作的结果对现在仍有影响，是新闻英语中报道“刚刚发生并已公布结果”事件的高频时态。第三人称单数主语用 has been，复数主语用 have been。
examples: Shanghai has been declared one of the winners of the first WIPO City of Innovation award.
The world's largest industrial fair has opened in Shanghai, showcasing cutting-edge technologies.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 -va- 上，读作 /ˌɪnəˈveɪʃn/。前面的 in- 弱读为 /ɪn/ 或 /ən/，不要读成 /ɪnˈnəʊ/。词尾 -tion 统一读 /ʃn/，注意 /ʃ/ 是清辅音，声带不振动。整词节奏为“短-短-长-短”。
examples: Shanghai is a city of innovation and opportunity.

reading.title: Shanghai: Where Ideas Become Industries
reading.content: Shanghai has been named one of the winners of the first WIPO City of Innovation award. The honor recognizes the city's ability to use intellectual property rights to drive innovation, protect original ideas and scale solutions from the lab to the market. Home to leading universities and research institutes, Shanghai has built a complete ecosystem in which patents, startups and manufacturers work side by side. At the same time, the world's largest industrial fair has opened in the city, showcasing cutting-edge robotics, artificial intelligence and smart manufacturing technologies. Together, these two events show how scientific research becomes real-world technology. Officials say the city will continue to invest in research and development and give strategic priority to emerging industries. For young learners, the message is clear: innovation is not only about having a good idea, but also about protecting it, developing it and sharing it with the world.
reading.translation: 上海被评为首届WIPO创新城市奖的获奖城市之一。这一荣誉认可了这座城市运用知识产权推动创新、保护原创创意并把解决方案从实验室推向市场的能力。作为众多顶尖高校和科研院所的所在地，上海构建了一个专利、初创企业与制造企业协同合作的完整生态。与此同时，全球规模最大的工业博览会在该市开幕，展示了尖端机器人、人工智能和智能制造技术。这两场活动共同展示了科学研究如何转化为现实技术。有关官员表示，上海将继续加大研发投入，并把战略性新兴产业放在优先位置。对年轻学习者而言，其中的道理很清晰：创新不只是拥有一个好点子，更在于保护它、发展它，并与世界分享它。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily《Shanghai wins inaugural city of innovation award》与 CGTN《World's largest industrial fair opens in Shanghai》两篇真实新闻改写，为学习目的进行了语言简化与整合。
